actor_sprites.description: Sprite sheets referenced by top-down SetSprite event commands, in event sprite-index order.

point_click_project.description: Native point-and-click contract with scenes, hotspots, cursor data, inventory items, dialogue lines, scripts, backgrounds and resource bank groups.

shmup_project.description: Native shoot-em-up contract with player, projectile settings, waves, enemies, scripts, dialogue lines, save config, optional backgrounds and resource bank groups.

score_enabled.description: Enables score accumulation and its HUD value.

high_score_enabled.description: Enables high-score persistence and its HUD value.

waves_enabled.description: Enables wave progression and its HUD value.

loop_waves.description: Loops to the initial wave when the last wave has no next wave.

visual_novel_project.description: Native Visual Novel contract with scenes, dialogue lines, conditional choice groups, choice scripts, choice scene targets, backgrounds and resource bank groups.

menu_project.description: Native Menu/UI contract with separate initial and in-game profiles, stack navigation, dynamic bindings, selectable items, conditional items, toggles/sliders by variable, dialogue lines, scripts, backgrounds, save config and resource bank groups.

cutscene_project.description: Native cutscene contract with scenes, timed timeline steps, conditional branches, skip control, dialogue wait, dialogue lines, scripts, optional backgrounds, save config and resource bank groups.

world_map_project.description: Native world map contract with map nodes, directional connections, conditional unlock variables, hidden/locked nodes, save config, scripts, dialogue lines, optional backgrounds and resource bank groups.
